headline: Xbox button icons land, and Difficulty gets a fix for loading on NTSC-U
summary: A new Xbox Icons mod replaces the game's button prompts with Xbox controller icons (#2). Difficulty's 1.2.2 source update fixes a function-name lookup that prevented the mod from loading on the US disc (#3). Its tests pass, but the author had not tried it on a real US disc, and no mod release was published that day.
highlights: The Difficulty incompatibility report #1 closes as completed after the lookup fix.
